In a patient with germline BRCA1 deficiency and acquired olaparib resistance, MRE11A amplification was associated with very high expression, increased DNA end resection and reacquisition of RAD51 foci, supporting HR restoration. Evidence is from a small clinical cohort; acquired SNVs should not be treated as resistance events without variant-specific functional evidence.

REF: Huang et al., Oncoscience, 2024; Fu et al., Genes and Diseases, 2024; Incognito et al., Front Oncol
